_doc: Agent E v5 domain-randomisation ranges. Written BEFORE any DR training or result (see NOTEBOOK.md). Grounding: v3/e/scenarios_v3.py (family generators) and v3/deliverables/02_SIMULATOR_VALIDATION.md section 5, which states that service times, patience, queue mix, base rates and shapes are INVENTED (no CallVerse contact logs). DR therefore expresses that parameter uncertainty around the nominal values; it does NOT claim the ranges are measured. Every training day draws ONE shift (all components independently) on top of a random TRAIN family; held-out V3 families are never generated by DR, and DR ranges are deliberately milder than the held-out refund_surge (B x2-3) and random_shape (knots 0.4-1.6) generators.

train_ranges._svc_mult: per-queue whole-day service-time multiplier. ASSUMPTION: service times 4/8/6/3 min are invented (02 sec.5); +-15 % uncertainty is about half of the temporary slowdown family (x1.3-1.7), so it is a plausible chronic mis-estimate, not a crisis.
train_ranges._pat_mult: per-queue patience multiplier. ASSUMPTION: patience 25/35/12/40 min is invented; +-20 % (patience is less certain than service time).
train_ranges._rho_mult: day-level demand multiplier on top of the family rho in {0.6..1.1}; real Olist day-to-day CV is 0.43 (already modelled by the 'volatile' family), so +-10 % is conservative.
train_ranges._shape_tilt: demand-shape shift: the family's intraday shape is multiplied by a smooth 4-knot curve in [0.8,1.2] and renormalised (mean 1). Milder than the held-out random_shape family (knots 0.4-1.6).
train_ranges._urgent_spike: queue-C (urgent / damaged item) arrival spike, 30-75 min. Mirrors the TRAIN tracking_spike generator (queue A x2.5-4, 6-15 steps) but on the queue where the V4 diagnosis found the failures; milder multiplier.
train_ranges._refund_surge: queue-B surge, deliberately BELOW the held-out refund_surge family (x2.0-3.0) so that family stays (mostly) unseen; flagged in reports: DR arms see milder B surges.
train_ranges._failure: capacity failure (sessions lost) on any family; TRAIN failure family is 4-8 sessions for 10-25 steps; DR adds milder 2-6 failures to other families (not stacked on the failure family).

_unseen_test_shifts: TEST5-only families, OUTSIDE the DR training ranges: whole-day service x1.20-1.35 on all queues (training max x1.15), patience x0.45-0.65 (training min x0.8), queue-C wave x2.8-3.5 for 90-150 min (training max x2.5 for 75 min). Base family = a random TRAIN family per day. Never used for training, selection or tuning; only generated for the TEST5 manifest.
